title: Perceptual implications of automatic anonymization in pathological speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating human discrimination accuracy (perceptual detectability) and subjective speech quality degradation of anonymized speech across different speech pathology groups (Cleft Lip and Palate, Dysarthria, Dysglossia, Dysphonia) compared to healthy controls.
Comparing human perceptual discrimination accuracy (Turing-style test) of anonymized speech samples between male and female speakers across all pathology and control groups.
Comparing subjective speech quality ratings and perceptual discrimination accuracy of anonymized speech between age-matched adult and child control groups.
